task: [Автозадача из бэклога] Hardening covered-after-restart recovery (`lib/task-action-evidence.ps1` новый fail-closed helper `Test-TaskCompletionRecoverable` + identity-keyed `task_started_at` в `driver/81:1657` + prepend `[task:<id>]` в auto-commit `driver/83:265` до truncation) · триггерится на restart/cap-hit реконсиляции в `driver/60:217`, covered-after-restart `driver/86:1465`, fast-path `driver/81:1466` ПЕРЕД пометкой failed · метрика: устраняет false-FAILED на готовых-закоммиченных задачах (инцидент SHA256: 9 рестартов→failed на верифицированном коде) — чистит outcome-ledger/24ч-вердикты и срезает рестарт-холостой ход · главный риск: false-DONE на шаблонных задачах → снят exact-id-match (не grep-по-тексту) + commit-relative AND-цепочкой (qa_head==HEAD ∧ critic.ts>=commit_ts), fail-closed; control-plane blast radius → canary+admission+rollback. NOT net-new: укрепление существующего covered-after-restart (FOUNDATION #2), новой подсистемы не вводит — OPERATOR_JUSTIFICATION не требуется.
goal: Eliminate false-FAILED statuses for completed and committed tasks, specifically addressing incidents where verified code tasks incorrectly fail after restarts. This will clean the outcome-ledger, improve 24-hour verdicts, and reduce wasted effort from restart-induced idle runs.
constraints: The recovery logic must trigger BEFORE a task is marked 'failed'.
Task identification must use exact-id-match, not text-based grep.
Task completion verification must use a commit-relative AND-chain: (qa_head==HEAD AND critic.ts>=commit_ts).
Control-plane blast radius must be mitigated via canary deployment, admission control, and rollback capabilities.
The solution must strengthen existing covered-after-restart functionality (FOUNDATION #2) and NOT introduce a net-new subsystem.
known_context: The task involves hardening an existing covered-after-restart recovery mechanism.
A new fail-closed helper `Test-TaskCompletionRecoverable` will be introduced in `lib/task-action-evidence.ps1`.
An identity-keyed `task_started_at` will be used in `driver/81:1657`.
Auto-commits in `driver/83:265` will be prepended with `[task:<id>]` before truncation.
The logic will be triggered by restart/cap-hit reconciliation in `driver/60:217`, covered-after-restart in `driver/86:1465`, and fast-path in `driver/81:1466`.
The motivation is an incident (SHA256) where 9 restarts led to 'failed' status on verified code.
The primary risk of 'false-DONE' on template tasks has been identified and mitigated by specific design choices (exact-id-match, commit-relative AND-chain, fail-closed, canary/admission/rollback).
success_tests: Simulate the '9 restarts -> failed on verified code' incident scenario and verify that tasks with verified code are no longer marked 'FAILED' after restarts/cap-hits.
Verify that `lib/task-action-evidence.ps1`'s `Test-TaskCompletionRecoverable` helper is correctly integrated and invoked.
Verify that `identity-keyed task_started_at` is correctly stored and retrieved from `driver/81:1657`.
Verify that auto-commits from `driver/83:265` correctly prepend `[task:<id>]` before truncation.

Verify that the new recovery logic correctly activates on `restart/cap-hit` in `driver/60:217`, `covered-after-restart` in `driver/86:1465`, and `fast-path` in `driver/81:1466` *before* a task is marked `FAILED`.
Verify that the `exact-id-match` logic (`qa_head==HEAD ∧ critic.ts>=commit_ts`) correctly prevents `false-DONE` on template tasks when an ID or timestamp mismatch occurs.
Monitor `outcome-ledger` for a measurable reduction in `false-FAILED` entries for completed tasks over a 24-hour period post-deployment.
Monitor system metrics for a reduction in 'restart-idle-run' or similar resource waste related to re-processing already completed tasks.
Verify that the system remains `fail-closed` in various unexpected or error scenarios.
